verdicts.evidence: (1) Repro docs/review-2026-10-31/repro/A2t-verify/reset-race.test.ts (+ vitest.config.ts, run.log) against a disposable PG18 on 127.0.0.1:55742 uses the real helpers/db.ts, setup.ts and global-setup.ts. Three overlapping resetDb() calls fail 3/3 runs with 'PostgresError: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "pg_database_datname_index"' (2 of 3 calls rejected each run). (2) The baseline shows the same cascade in the wild, docs/review-2026-10-31/baseline/backend-test.log. At lines 273-346 a 'Hook timed out in 30000ms' in a resetDb beforeEach is followed in the same worker by 'duplicate key ... pg_database_datname_index' and 'database "postgres_87470_mvwu62uq_w8" already exists' in unrelated tests. Line 593 has the same for _w1, line 603 has vitest's 'This might cause false positive tests', and the totals are 20 failed files / 44 failed tests. (3) Code: apps/backend/tests/helpers/db.ts:134-155 resetDb has no in-process mutex or promise chain. Contrast ensureWorkerDb at db.ts:66-71, which memoises exactly because 'a hook that timed out leaves its build running'. The comment at db.ts:132-133 ('runs its tests sequentially, so no cross-process lock is needed') overlooks that vitest does not cancel a timed-out hook's promise. DROP IF EXISTS / CREATE from two overlapping calls race on pg_database.
verdicts.reason: Reproduced deterministically and visible in the baseline run. The harness turns one slow reset into several unrelated failures, which hides real regressions in the noise. It is test infrastructure only, with no prod impact, so P2 (drift that will bite) is the right rating. Serialising would not make the original slow test pass. The fix is to chain resetDb on a module-level promise (as ensureWorkerDb does), so the next caller waits for the in-flight reset instead of racing it.
